svg.title: headless-kit
svg.desc: headless-kit: cheap, agent-first tools that need no browser, no API keys and no windows. 20 tools and hooks, 0 dependencies, all 26 child-process calls hidden, under 50 ms a call (median, measured). A terminal cycles through four real runs: reddit-pull prints one JSON line while 232,750 bytes go to disk; memory-gate answers ok with exit 0; lane-model-check catches a model mismatch with exit 1; plan-depth lists the gaps in a plan without approving it.
